title: Writer Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W2 fan-out migration of the ✒️writer plugin per the crate-consolidation-and-plugin-taxonomy-restructure initiative (master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE, following the W1 flow pilot's TEMPLATE.md exactly). Merge writer's 7 old constitutional crates (manifest/artifact, app facade, op, engine, dsl, pack, protocol, ui) into ONE crate semio-s-plugin-writer at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/✒️writer/📦️packages/🦀️rust with the full taxonomy tree (🗿️artifacts/✒️writer/{diff,op,dsl,pack,spr,engine}, 🎛️apps/✒️writer/{config,terminology,wasm,commands/*,modes/edit/windows/main/options/*,panels/*}). Verify cargo check (native+wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, cargo test with wire-format byte-identical proof against a captured baseline, then delete old crate manifests and hand off registrar instructions. Never touch root Cargo.toml/script.ts/registry/launch.json or any other plugin's directory.
summary: Migrated ✒️writer's 7 old constitutional crates (manifest/artifact bundle, app facade, op, engine, dsl, pack, protocol, ui) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-writer` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/✒️writer/📦️packages/🦀️rust with the full taxonomy tree per TEMPLATE.md: 🗿️artifacts/✒️writer/{component,diff,op,dsl,pack,spr,engine}; 🎛️apps/✒️writer/{component,config,terminology,wasm,commands/{text,camera,inspect,selection,editor-settings,engagement,locale},modes/edit/{component,windows/main/{component,options/{font-size,line-height,tab-size,line-numbers}}},panels/{document,catalogue,inspection}}. WriterCommand rebuilt via app_commands! (24 rows, non-ctx keyed form) with every payload's #[dsl(keyword=...)] verified against a captured wire baseline (before/after hex diff on all 24 variants, byte-identical; 3 Option-bearing rows pinned as a permanent regression test). Relocated the stray writer-languages manifest.json to 🗿️artifacts/✒️writer/🛂️manifest.json. Verification: cargo check native (0 warnings), cargo check wasm32-wasip2 (0 warnings, ~19min due to concurrent-sibling CPU contention), cargo clippy -D warnings (clean after fixing needless_lifetimes/unnecessary_map_or/unnecessary_sort_by/type_complexity/unnecessary_wraps/unused_qualifications/unused_imports), cargo test (86/86 passing — restored 3 test-coverage gaps found during migration: two window_engagements tests and full-surface locale cross-checks that had been narrowed when splitting per-node). Old crate directories deleted only after all four gates were green. Fixed the two repo-wide cross-plugin dependents (dsl fixture-sweep and dsl-registry) to point at the new merged crate. Registrar must still: prune root Cargo.toml's 8 old writer member lines + the semio-s-app-writer workspace.dependencies line, add the new member, and regenerate the plugin registry/launch.json (registry check confirms staleness as expected, not run write/generate myself).
